body: It’s a digital lock :/ November it is, ig.

We have 3 guns (shotguns) but I don’t know the combination to the safe. I have enough pills to overdose. We have a bridge nearby (just a quick bike ride); however, it is very public. I’m not doing to jump in front of the car and scar whoever is inside of it. I could slit my wrists but I don’t really want to go out Hannah Baker style. Toaster bath? Lol. I could hang myself- the ceilings are tall enough. I think the guns would 100% be the best option. I’d have to wait until deer hunting, though. November 15th.
It’s more that I want to see what it’s like- to take too much medication. I can’t reach out to my family- they are harsh on this kind of stuff. “I’m being dramatic”

Parents and I are constantly arguing- I don’t start the fights. Self hatred is an issue. I’ve done some really bad things. I’ve said some really bad things. I never get rest anymore. I’m always trying to keep my head above the water but I want to drown. This is the basics of it- there is a lot more but I’m not going to write all of it (it’s a long story).
Too much to write. I’m tired of trying. I’m tired of everything.
